snapshot.title: 71st CARPHA Annual Health Research Conference — One Health
snapshot.whyThisHotel: Qualified prospect for selective accommodation and small ancillary hospitality, not the main conference venue. The announced meeting is on the SGU campus. Spice Island’s 64 luxury villa-style suites and all-inclusive beach-resort positioning suggest a possible fit for self-paying senior delegates, speakers or partner representatives whose travel policies allow it, plus optional pre/post stays. None of those segments is a confirmed booking. A small private dinner or reception is worth qualifying; the resort publishes wedding/event services for up to 35 guests, but that is not verified corporate meeting capacity. Do not assume the conference’s exhibition, catering or networking spend will move from campus to this hotel. Breakfast-only options merit discussion because delegates may spend conference days away from the resort.

snapshot.recommendedNextStep: Send a short, permission-based accommodation enquiry to conference@carpha.org, asking for the named 2027 accommodation/logistics lead and whether CARPHA, SGU, the ministry or individual delegates source and pay for hotels. Ask whether Roxanne Colthrust remains involved; use Veron Guy-Parks as an alternative administrative referral and Rhonda-Joy Lewis for routing if needed. Suggested positioning: “Could you direct us to the person coordinating accommodation for the 21–23 April 2027 conference? Spice Island would like to assess whether a limited suite allocation or small private hospitality event could fit your needs. Please confirm the sourcing process, permitted rate basis and transport requirements.” Only then prepare a tailored proposal with availability, inclusions, cancellation terms and campus transport options. Do not claim preferred-hotel status, offer personal inducements, buy sponsorship on the assumption it secures room business, or displace the campus venue.
